## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] Changes to the page have a browser test in `e2e/`, and new lists or labels have content in `e2e/layout.spec.ts`
- [ ] Anything that could only be tested against the simulators is listed under "Known gaps" in the changelog

## Kept in step

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Help page (`web/src/help.ts`) and README, if behaviour changed
